scope: Independent read-only arithmetic and saved-evidence audit; no target execution or timing rerun

baseline.manifest_separator_normalization: Windows and POSIX separators normalized for path identity only; file bytes unchanged

candidate.manifest_separator_normalization: Windows and POSIX separators normalized for path identity only; file bytes unchanged

baseline.profile_file_index_encoding: Sorted objects {file: basename, sha256: actual digest}; canonical JSON sort_keys=true, separators=(comma, colon), UTF-8

candidate.profile_file_index_encoding: Sorted objects {file: basename, sha256: actual digest}; canonical JSON sort_keys=true, separators=(comma, colon), UTF-8

normalization.event_payload: All event fields retained, replacing only per-trial root, generated attempt IDs by preparation order, and final Git HEAD
normalization.comparison: Full normalized events and event results; execution argv/purpose/outcome/exit/snapshot hashes; final fixture source hashes; retained failure records
normalization.receipt_checks: Actual receipt/request/log bytes and digests, state adoption, request binding, before/after stability, cleanup and same-candidate formal facts
normalization.warmups: pair=-1 and warmup=true, exactly one per arm per scenario, excluded from every statistic
normalization.source_manifests: Normalize manifest path separators. Baseline archive contains six preexisting bytecode cache files excluded from the measured copy/source map; no non-cache source entry omitted and measured source inventories match exactly.

limitations: This audit consumes retained records; it does not rerun targets or restore historical product bytes.
The CLI benchmark uses explicit mechanical fixtures for qualification and code reviews; it does not measure independent agent review or real workflow compliance.
Results apply to these two native Windows/Python 3.12.10 scenarios, not model inference, queueing, agent handoffs, or full-task speed.
Outer launches are actual commands.jsonl entries; descendant process totals are not inferred.
Profile runs are separately instrumented and excluded from paired timing; cumulative profile times overlap and must not be summed as wall time.
Observed comparable target work, retained audit counts and reduced launches/import calls support mechanical overhead reduction; they do not establish a universal speed ratio.
audit_self_correction: Initial audit comparison did not normalize baseline manifest separators or distinguish its six archived bytecode caches from measured sources. Direct file inventory and byte comparisons corrected the audit rule; no benchmark input or outcome changed.
